business_summary: China Resources New Energy Holdings Company Limited engages in investing, developing, operating, and managing wind and solar power plants in China. Its wind power installed capacity is 27.63 million kilowatts; and photovoltaic power capacity is 13.96 million kilowatts. China Resources New Energy Holdings Company Limited was founded in 2010 and is based in Shenzhen, China. The company operates as a subsidiary of China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited.
business_summary_ko: China Resources New Energy Holdings Company Limited는 중국의 풍력 및 태양광 발전소에 대한 투자, 개발, 운영 및 관리에 종사하고 있습니다. 풍력 발전 설비 용량은 2,763만 킬로와트입니다. 태양광 발전 용량은 1,396만 킬로와트이다. China Resources New Energy Holdings Company Limited는 2010년에 설립되었으며 중국 심천에 본사를 두고 있습니다. 이 회사는 China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited의 자회사로 운영됩니다.
